pictures.author: George Mel;noise/crop edits by Commons contributors
pictures.observed: Actually inspected complete east/southeast exterior. Cream/tan ashlar body,high central east gable and lower shoulders,two deep narrow pointed V-section facade recesses,big centered carved cross/slit field,two small circular reliefs and linked round blind arches. Tall faceted narrow-window drum supports a pointed brown/gray conical cap and cross. This older image shows silver-gray lower roofs;later2019 picture controls red tile finish instead. Fine carving,lettering and exact window/niche dimensions simplified.

pictures.author: Ser Amantio di Nicolao
pictures.observed: Actually inspected whole southern body and lower facade. Red tiled upper nave and lower lean-to roofs flank a taller narrow transverse gable;one high slender round-headed window and small circular carved field fill the cross-arm front. Uneven pale tan stone blocks carry round blind arcade ribs and narrow paired supports. Small doorway is near the western lower side;the eastern lower bays are blind masonry. Dome/drum is continuous above the roof crossing. Approximate partition/entry details only;people,grass and surrounding compound do not become facade textures.

pictures.author: Kober
pictures.observed: Actually inspected east panorama. Separate low ruined enclosure/ranges and small bell tower stand well away from the main church;they are not merged into its rectangular map footprint. East tall gable/cross and two narrow deep recesses remain visible with high cone/drum. Distant panorama only supports overall context and signed east facade;not precise detail,roof finish,heights or ground survey.
